howto: Tap each 🐹 mole as it pops up, before it ducks back down.
⭐ gold moles are worth 5, 👑 crowns 10; a 🎃 boss takes three taps for 25.
Don't tap the 💣: it rumbles before it pops up and costs 3 points.
tips: Five hits in a row without letting one escape raises the multiplier (up to x3).
A hit within 350 ms of a mole popping up earns a +1 speed bonus.
Moles pop up faster and stay up for less time as the clock runs down.
On a keyboard, the number pad layout (7 8 9 / 4 5 6 / 1 2 3) matches the holes.

controls.keyboard: Number keys 1 to 9 whack the matching hole (number-pad layout); Space starts. P or Esc pauses.

difficulty: An adaptive curve inside each round: moles appear faster and hide sooner as the timer runs down, and bosses arrive every 100 points.

cheats.effect: Big hammer: a whack also hits the moles next door
No bombs: only moles pop up

features.one-tap-start: Play starts the 30-second round at once
features.instant-restart: Play Again (or Space) on the results card starts a new round
features.best-score-badge: 🏆 best in the top bar next to the score
features.tutorial-card: First-round card with a tapping finger that stays until your first whack
features.results: Time's Up card with score, best, new-best badge and rank
